questions.prompt: What does correct shaft alignment seek to achieve?
questions.answer: Both shafts rotating about the same centerline
options: Both shafts rotating about the same centerline
questions.explanation: Alignment places the shaft axes on the same centerline and reduces forces caused by offset or angular error.

questions.prompt: Which misalignment means the shaft centerlines are parallel but displaced?
questions.explanation: Parallel misalignment is an offset between parallel axes; angular misalignment is a difference in their angle.
